body.cap: VERSES PM Sanghyup Lee (left) introduces ‘Aespa World’ to AVING News reporter Jay Kennedy Marcus at Pre-CES2025 in Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: VERSES, Inc. (CEO Sean Lee) participated in the ‘Pre-CES2025 Incheon (IFEZ)’ held on November 13 at the Grand Ballroom C of Songdo Convensia.

VERSES is a music-tech startup pioneering user-driven music experiences. Recognizing that traditional music is limited to auditory enjoyment, the company integrates AI to create a new era of music in which users interact directly with musicians, explore themed virtual worlds, and shape their experiences based on personal preferences. VERSES aims to redefine music from a listening activity to a participatory and creative process.

At CES 2025 in Las Vegas, VERSES plans to highlight its flagship product, Aespa World, and introduce its upcoming multimodal generative AI engine. The company seeks to connect with global clients and partners in AI, metaverse, and music industries while targeting investors and collaborators for technology co-development.

Aespa World is an interactive music platform co-created with K-pop group Aespa and hosted on the metaverse platform ZEPETO. It allows users to customize avatars and explore a virtual music-themed world, appealing particularly to Gen Z audiences.

Launched on August 1, 2023, in collaboration with SM Entertainment, Aespa World has amassed over 550,000 cumulative visits and 200,000 related posts on ZEPETO. Fans can meet Aespa members, take photos, dance, and create personalized music videos. The virtual world reflects Aespa’s music and storylines through tracks like “Drama,” “Supernova,” and “Armageddon.”

body.cap: VERSES booth at Pre-CES2025 in Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Unlike traditional music consumption, users actively control music by navigating through the space, akin to playing an instrument. Aespa World incorporates award-winning technologies such as the Meta Music System, which earned CES 2023’s Best Innovation Award, and AI-powered beat-based music video generation, recognized at CES 2024. VERSES plans to continuously update the platform with new content inspired by Aespa’s music.

At CES 2025, VERSES will unveil its multimodal generative AI engine, which automates the creation of metaverse-based interactive music worlds. This technology reduces production time and costs, presenting new opportunities for the music industry. The engine can process text, audio, visuals, and motion data, enhancing context comprehension and delivering dynamic, real-time user experiences.

VERSES has collaborated with major players like SM Entertainment, JAY-Z’s Roc Nation, and Universal Music. The company previously launched projects such as Fightman: SUMIN’s Interactive Single, recognized at CES 2022 and 2023 iF Design Awards, and the Hitchhiker Metaverse Music app, developed with EDM producer Hitchhiker.

body.cap: Demonstration of Aespa World. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: VERSES’ innovative efforts have been recognized by Google’s Asia AI program Cloud Academy (2023), NVIDIA’s Inception global collaboration program (2024), Billboard’s Best Metaverse Music Innovation at CES 2023, and the Shinhan Square Bridge HERO’s AWARDS for Next Technology (2022). From 2022 to 2025, the company has consistently won CES Innovation Awards and iF Design Awards.

A VERSES representative stated, “Through Aespa World, we’ve enabled music fans to meet stars they wouldn’t encounter, engage in conversations, and even create music videos together in a metaverse space. In 2025, we aim to offer our multimodal generative AI engine to artists worldwide, facilitating the creation of interactive music worlds and leading the popularization of metaverse music.”

The representative added, “By collaborating with partners such as SM Entertainment, Universal Music Group, Google, and NVIDIA, we aim to seamlessly integrate innovative music experiences into everyday life.”

Organized by the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZA) and Incheon Technopark, ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ’ is part of the ‘Global Top 10 City Incheon Week’ held in the third week of November. Integrating five related events, the event focuses on key themes like healthcare, bio, and smart cities. On November 13, the IFEZ Smart City Tech Conference and the CES2025 Incheon Pavilion showcase occurred concurrently.
